text:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT ALERT — p95 latency regression on /v1/generate in us-west-2 :rotating_light:

Oncall Bot: Paging @Maria P., @Ajay K., @Sophie L. — severity: high, customer-impact: some streaming sessions stalled, elevated p99.

Maria P.: saw the alert: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~1.3s, p99 ~5s. Streaming stall traces show long waits on KV fetchs and increased paging to disk.

Ajay K.: confirming low prefix cache hit rate. dashboard snapshot:
- prefix_cache_hit: 92% -> 14%
- paging ops/sec up 8x
- stream stalls/errors +350%

Sophie L.: any recent deploys?

Corey M. (ml infra): rolled the new prefix-hash change in canary 30m ago, then promoted to 60% 18m ago. The change adjusts the seed/bitmask for prefix hashing to balance shard load.

Tim G.: looks like the new hash is causing effective prefix collisions or misalignment with warmup keys. Keys that used to map to hot shards are now routed differently, causing cold misses and heavy paging.

Maria P.: logs from one streaming worker (snippet):
```
[2026-06-12T15:03:21Z] fetch_prefix_cache miss key=chat:usr:ab12 prefix=6a4f
[2026-06-12T15:03:21Z] KV backend page_read start id=page-9876
[2026-06-12T15:03:24Z] page_read end latency=2900ms
[2026-06-12T15:03:24Z] stream: stall client=cli-33b status=timeout
```

Ajay K.: we need to stop the rollout and consider quick mitigations. Options:
1) rollback prefix-hash to previous seed (fast config flip)
2) reduce rollout to 0% (stop canary)
3) force warmup for newly affected shards
4) rate-limit/slow-path some low-priority tenants to protect SLOs

Sophie L.: actioning option 2 & 1 in parallel. I'm going to push a rollback flag to the hash service and scale up the in-memory cache replicas for hot shard coverage.

Sophie L.: running command to set flag:
```bash
# set prefix hash seed back to stable
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/configs/prefix-hash -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"seed":"stable-20260510","rollout":0}'
```

Oncall Bot: @Sophie L. elevated to incident lead. Notifying duty roster for 2h handoff.

Sophie L.: applied rollback flag, waiting for config propagation (rolling config to 60% -> 100% takes ~30s per zone). Also bumped cache-replicas in us-west-2 by +2.

Tim G.: initiated synthetic warmers to prefetch hot prefixes for top 20 tenants. Command:
```bash
./tools/prefetch --targets-file hot_prefixes.csv --region us-west-2 --rate 200
```

Maria P.: early telemetry: cache_hit recovering 14% -> 48% in 4m after rollback and warmers. p95 dropped from 1.3s -> 320ms. p99 trending down but still elevated (~1.8s).

Corey M. (ml infra): paging throughput still high; eviction pressure increased during the roll for keys that migrated off hot nodes. Need to watch backend IO.

Ajay K.: mitigation checklist updated in incident doc: revert + warmups + replica bump + temporary tenant throttling. Also opening a slow-path throttle gate on non-SLA tenants (50% RPS cap).

Sophie L.: applying tenant throttle for non-SLA customers in us-west-2 now.

Sophie L.: applied. Noticed a side-effect: some background batch jobs that relied on full throughput are backpressuring. Maria please monitor backlog.

Maria P.: on it — queue depth increased for non-critical queues but critical customer flows are stable. Not seeing new user-facing errors.

Tim G.: note for postmortem — the rollout lacked a pre-deploy cache mapping simulation. We need a canary check that compares expected shard affinity for a sample of keys.

Oncall Bot: Escalation: If p99 > 3s for more than 10m, page SRE. We're currently at p99 ~1.3s and falling.

Maria P.: coordinating customer comms: Support draft: "We observed increased latency impacting streaming sessions in US-West due to an internal routing change. We've rolled back the change and applied mitigations; customers may see restored performance shortly. We'll follow up with a timeline and postmortem." Anyone want to add?

Ajay K.: add note about rate-limit applied to non-SLA tenants and that customer-specific issues should open a support ticket referencing INC-2215006789.

Sophie L.: handing off active monitoring to @Tim G. for next 2 hours. I'll continue on postmortem actions and RCA. Handoff notes:
- rollback applied at 15:06:34Z
- warmers started at 15:07:10Z
- replica bump completed at 15:08:40Z
- tenant throttle active at 15:09:00Z
- current metrics: p95=310ms, p99=1.1s, prefix_cache_hit=68%

Tim G.: ack. I'll watch p95/p99 and paging ops, and will escalate to SRE if p99 stabilizes >2s or paging ops remain >3x baseline for >15m.

Corey M. (ml infra): creating a short-term alert to fire if prefix_cache_hit < 50% for >5m post-rollback — to detect incomplete propagation/warmup.

Maria P.: uploaded a quick incident note in #incidents-log and pinged support. Drafting postmortem skeleton.

Sophie L.: Next steps (action items):
- (Ajay) PR to add a pre-deploy shard-affinity simulation and gate (due EOD)
- (Corey) add rollback propagation verification to rollout orchestration (2d)
- (Maria) customer comms and finalize incident summary (1 business day)
- (Tim) monitor and close incident when metrics stable for 30m (in progress)

Maria P.: final status check at 15:45Z shows p95=180ms, p99=420ms, prefix_cache_hit=89%, paging ops ~1.2x baseline. I'll mark incident as mitigated and begin postmortem writeup.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED — severity lowered to informational.

Sophie L.: thanks team. Leaving follow-ups in the incident doc. Handoff complete.

Tim G.: closing monitoring loop; will re-open if we regress. Good job all :thumbsup:
